name: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-A data center / SPARK campus
notes: QST announced Saudi data-center capacity in 2022, including sites at King Salman Energy Park (SPARK), which is described in press coverage as outside Abqaiq/Buqayq. Project-finance coverage identified the first site as a 7.5 MW data center intended to reach operations in March 2022. DatacenterMap lists DMM-A as an operational carrier-neutral QST facility at SPARK. Public sources differ on whether reported 60 MW refers to aggregate program capacity rather than this first facility, so capacity_mw uses the financing-specific 7.5 MW figure.

name: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-B data center / SPARK expansion
notes: Project-finance coverage said the second QST data center was also located at SPARK, with 9 MW capacity and expected commercial operation in July 2023. DatacenterMap and Reboot Monkey list DMM-B as an operational carrier-neutral QST facility in the Dammam/Khobar market. Mapped locality is the broader Dammam market, but the project source places it at SPARK near Abqaiq/Buqayq.

name: EDGNEX / DAMAC Digital DMM01 Dammam data center
developer: EDGNEX Data Centres by DAMAC / DAMAC Digital
notes: Dgtl Infra reported that EDGNEX opened a 20 MW Dammam facility in September 2023. DatacenterMap lists DAMAC Digital DMM01 as operational and gives a Buqayq postal address, matching this batch division. EDGNEX's own Saudi Arabia location page confirms Dammam/Saudi presence but does not expose the full facility details in the accessible page text.
